MemoryAnalysis.Title: Memory Analysis
MemoryAnalysis.Description: Inspect process memory, collection evidence, retained history and explicit host diagnostics.

Overview.Title: Memory overview
Overview.Description: Read the process footprint and GC-reported heap context without forcing a collection.

Gc.Title: Garbage collection
Gc.Description: Understand the latest reported collection through pause evidence and signed generation movement.

History.Title: Memory history
History.Description: Follow the retained observation window and inspect the exact samples behind memory trends.

Allocations.Title: Type allocations
Allocations.Description: Compare attributed allocation ticks with an explicit heap census, keeping each source distinct.

Diagnostics.Title: Memory diagnostics
Diagnostics.Description: Run permitted host actions deliberately and retain their actual outcomes independently of view refreshes.

Messages.Retained: The last successful view and its read time remain visible.
Messages.NoSnapshot: No successful view is available yet.

Page.AllocationUnavailableDescription: This host has not selected the optional type-allocation backend. Process memory, GC evidence and history remain available.

Collections.Title: Collections since process start
Collections.Help: Lifetime totals from GC.CollectionCount; refreshing this view does not reset them.

Sources.ImmediateHelp: Working set and managed memory are read from the running process without requesting a collection.
Sources.LastGcHelp: Heap and committed memory are the values returned by GC.GetGCMemoryInfo. Their observation basis differs from the process read.
Sources.Independent: These measurements overlap and have different observation bases. They are not parts of a total.

LastCollection.Title: Collection evidence
LastCollection.NoTimestamp: Collection details have no separate timestamp. This time identifies the successful view read.
LastCollection.NoCollectionHelp: GC index 0 means this runtime has not reported a completed collection. Process memory reads can still be available.
LastCollection.EmptyHelp: A successful GC evidence read is not available in this view yet.

Heap.Title: Heap and object counters
Heap.Scope: Reported by this GC; pinned and pending values are object counts.

SystemMemory.Title: Memory context at the GC
SystemMemory.Scope: Load, availability and threshold belong to the GC report. This is not a current OS free-memory probe.

Generations.Title: Before and after this collection
Generations.Scope: Signed decrease = before − after. A negative value is growth; it is not a failure or an exact freed-object count.

Pause.DurationHelp: Maximum of up to two reported pause durations.
Pause.ShareHelp: Pause percentage since runtime load, updated when GC completes.

Raw.Title: Exact recorded evidence
Raw.Scope: Unscaled bytes and counters preserve the reported precision.

Trend.Waiting: No retained sample is available yet. The collector and this view have independent read intervals.

Generations.Title: The latest generation reading
Generations.Help: Five independently reported counters from the newest sample. This is a snapshot, not a generation time trend.

Recent.Title: The sample ledger
Recent.Empty: No memory observations have been captured.
Recent.Help: Newest first · all retained samples are reachable. Inspect a row for its original values and timestamp.

Trend.WindowHelp: Averages weight each retained sample equally; they are not time-weighted estimates.
Trend.AllocationUnit: Reported rate · binary MiB/s · time axis
Trend.MeasurementHelp: History belongs to the host collector. Pausing view reads does not stop collection. Separate plots preserve different units; cached counters may initially be zero.
Trend.NoRetention: The host retains no samples. Current process reads are still available.
Trend.SingleRetention: This host retains only one sample. Inspect its evidence below; a time trend needs at least two.
Trend.SingleWaiting: The first sample is available below. A second observation is needed for a time trend.

Allocation.Title: Allocation workspace
Allocation.DroppedEvents: {0} current-process ticks were skipped for missing type names or invalid byte values. This is not ETW transport loss.

Sources.LiveHelp: Current-process AllocationTick events. Counts and attributed-byte estimates accumulate until reset; they are not a complete object census.
Sources.HeapHelp: Non-free objects enumerated in a process snapshot clone. These counts and bytes are not allocation traffic or a guarantee of root reachability.
Sources.ModeHelp: Low and High currently use the same AllocationTick strategy. These compatibility names do not specify a sampling percentage.
Sources.Preserved: Live updates are retained separately while a heap census is selected.
Sources.Timing: Active ETW evidence uses its view time; stopped evidence retains its stop time. Heap evidence uses scan completion time, not exact clone creation time.
Sources.DurationHelp: ETW duration describes the current or last session window, while counters accumulate until reset. Heap duration describes the scan operation.

Ranking.Title: Types behind the observation
Ranking.Coverage: Shares use the full source total. Excluded types are omitted; removed ranking rows can remain in the ETW cumulative totals. This view cannot measure ETW transport loss.

Capabilities.WindowsRequired: Windows is required for ETW tracking and process-snapshot heap capture.
Capabilities.HeapVersion: Process-snapshot heap capture requires Windows 8.1 / Server 2012 R2 or newer.
Capabilities.Etw: Live tracking requires permission to create an ETW session. Actual access failures are reported when starting.
Capabilities.Heap: Heap capture uses a process snapshot clone and requires host access. It can consume additional memory and CPU.

Errors.Retained: The last successful source views remain retained.
Errors.SourceFailed: The evidence source reported a failure.

Empty.LiveHelp: The collector is idle with no retained type evidence. Start tracking when you need an observation window.
Empty.CollectingHelp: Collection is active, but this view has no retained type rows yet. Exclusions and dropped events can affect coverage.
Empty.HeapHelp: Capture a process-snapshot heap census to inspect retained objects independently of live allocation traffic.
Empty.NoMatchesHelp: Change or clear the full-name query. The source totals remain unchanged.
Empty.UnreadHelp: The collector state and its type evidence have not been read successfully. Refresh to read the actual host state.

Details.Title: Type evidence
Details.OpenFailed: The type inspector could not be opened.
Details.Frozen: This type, source and its totals stay fixed while the page and live collector continue to update.
Details.NoObjectSize: Allocation ticks do not reveal individual object sizes. No per-object size or heap-membership claim is inferred.

ManualGc.Title: Force collection
ManualGc.Description: Request a forced, blocking collection for the selected generation. This action changes the running process.
ManualGc.Disabled: Manual collection is disabled by the host’s UI policy.
ManualGc.Effect: The facade uses non-compacting defaults. A completed request is not proof that a leak was resolved.

Dump.Title: Create GC dump
Dump.Description: Create a GC dump through the host’s native diagnostic tool. Capture may pause or add load to the process.
Dump.Disabled: GC dump creation is disabled by the host’s UI policy.
Dump.Prerequisite: The host identity needs access to the tool, diagnostic process and output directory. The page does not install or elevate a tool.
Dump.ServerFile: The returned path belongs to the server filesystem. No browser download is implied.

Policy.Permitted: Permitted by this host’s UI policy

Diagnostics.Scope: These actions target this host process. View reads do not perform diagnostics; an admitted native action is observed to completion even if the page is left.
Diagnostics.ManualRead: Manual view reads · no polling on this route
